- Total revenue reached £124,910.08 TW, representing a +209.3% WoW increase from £40,389.09 LW.
- PICNIC BASKET WICKER 60 PIECES dominated sales with £39,619.50 TW revenue, capturing 31.7% of total TW share and ranking as the top product.
- PARTY BUNTING generated £4,019.93 TW revenue with a +72.8% WoW increase, securing the rank 2 position.
- DOORMAT BLACK FLOCK experienced the largest WoW surge, growing +14502.5% from £15.90 LW to £2,321.80 TW.
- DOORMAT KEEP CALM AND COME IN showed strong momentum with a +339.7% WoW increase, reaching £2,800.73 TW and ranking third.
- TEA TIME PARTY BUNTING recorded the largest YoY growth at +2828.5%, rising from £15.90 LY to current week performance.
- SET/4 WHITE RETRO STORAGE CUBES posted the largest WoW decline at -68.1%, falling from £1,123.52 LW to £357.89 TW.
- JUMBO BAG RED RETROSPOT generated the most orders with 59 TW compared to 29 LW, indicating strong customer demand.
